description: Having a policy is what an organisation produces when asked whether it takes something seriously, and having one is legally useful whether or not it operates.
energy_note: The document exists. That is its function.

description: The metric is the percentage who clicked through the module. Nobody measures whether anything changed.
energy_note: Ninety-eight per cent completion, zero per cent difference.

description: 'We have zero tolerance. That's not a slogan, it's who we are.' Two rows back sits the person whose third complaint was closed as unsubstantiated last month. He gets a round of applause.
energy_note: Zero tolerance, applauded, two rows from the evidence.

aspect: It makes the next complaint harder
description: Where an organisation has loudly declared itself good on this, the complainant is contradicting the institution's self-image as well as one person's account.
energy_note: Now you are also calling the company a liar.
